raw_segments.text: King Richard come hither caddis be rumor it abroad that and my wife is very grievous sick
I will take order for her keeping close
Inquire me out some mean poor gentleman whom I will marry straight to Clarence daughter
The boy is foolish and I fear not him look how thou dreams tea
I say again give out that and my queen is sick and like to die about it for it stands me much upon to stop
All hopes whose growth may damage me
